'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh]]
**[[Samvel Shahramanyan]], [[President of Artsakh|president]] of the breakaway [[Republic of Artsakh]], signs a decree to dissolve all state [[Government of Artsakh|institutions of Artsakh]] in 2024. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/09/28/europe/nagorno-karabakh-officially-dissolve-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2023 Burkina Faso coup d'état attempt]]
**The [[Patriotic Movement for Safeguard and Restoration|ruling]] [[September 2022 Burkina Faso coup d'état|military government]] of [[Burkina Faso]] arrests four officers suspected of attempting to stage a [[coup]]. Two additional officers are on the run. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/28/africa/burkina-faso-foiled-coup-attempt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Insurgency in Manipur]]
**[[2023 Manipur violence]]
***More than 80 people are injured during [[riot]]s that occurred during [[protest]]s over the [[murder in Indian law|murder]] of two [[Meitei people|Meitei]] students in [[Manipur]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/28/curfew-in-parts-of-indias-manipur-after-protests-over-killing-of-students (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Niger]]
**[[Jihadism|Jihadist]] [[insurgent]]s kill at least ten [[Niger Armed Forces|Nigerien soldiers]] in Kandadji, [[Tillabéri Region]], [[Niger]]. Seven soldiers are later killed and five others are injured in a vehicle accident while travelling to reinforce the army unit under attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-ten-niger-soldiers-killed-militant-attack-2023-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Six teenagers who were [[kidnap]]ped by a group of armed men a few days ago are found dead near [[Villanueva, Zacatecas|Villanueva]], [[Zacatecas]], [[Mexico]]. [https://english.elpais.com/international/2023-09-28/six-bodies-and-one-survivor-found-in-search-for-kidnapped-teens-in-zacatecas-mexico.html?outputType=amp (''El País'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tashkent explosion]]
**One person is killed and 162 others are injured in an [[explosion]] at a [[warehouse]] near the [[Islam Karimov Tashkent International Airport|airport]] in [[Tashkent]], [[Uzbekistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/28/powerful-blast-near-uzbekistans-tashkent-airport-kills-one-injures-162 (Al Jazeera)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 dengue outbreak in Bangladesh]]
**Nearly 1,000 people have died of [[dengue fever]] in [[Bangladesh]] in recent weeks, in the country's most severe [[Disease outbreak|outbreak]] of the disease so far. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66944315 (BBC News)]
*A [[bluetongue disease]] outbreak in the [[Netherlands]] has spread to 319 sheep and cattle farming companies. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2492159-blauwtongvirus-rukt-op-in-nederland-besmettingen-op-honderden-plekken (NOS)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Rotterdam shootings]]
**Three people are killed during two shootings and an [[arson]] attack at a [[teaching hospital]] and a nearby private home in [[Rotterdam]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/dutch-police-say-two-wounded-rotterdam-shooting-2023-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Crime in Sweden]]
**A woman is killed in her house in [[Uppsala]], [[Sweden]], during a bombing attack intended to target the neighbor next door, while two men were killed and another was injured during two shootings the day before in [[Stockholm]] and [[Jordbro]], as deadly violence linked to a feud between [[organized crime in Sweden|criminal gangs]] escalates. [https://www.euronews.com/2023/09/28/3-killed-in-shootings-and-explosion-as-gangs-battle-in-sweden (Euronews)]
**[[Prime Minister of Sweden|Swedish Prime Minister]] [[Ulf Kristersson]] summons the heads of the [[Swedish Armed Forces|armed forces]] and [[Law enforcement in Sweden|police]] in response to the gang violence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/sweden-opposition-party-calls-military-tackle-deadly-gang-war-2023-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*The historic [[Sycamore Gap Tree]] in [[Northumberland]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], also known as the "[[Robin Hood]]"-tree, is illegally cut down. A 16-year-old boy is arrested. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tyne-66952980 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Gravitational interaction of antimatter]]
**The [[ALPHA experiment]] shows that [[antimatter]] falls down in [[gravity]], just like normal matter. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-66890649 (BBC News)]
